official_dev.description: Official Techfest Challenge 1 dev set (official-dev-set/ps1-anticipatory-commerce/dev.jsonl, 300 streaming requests on the 1,074-product official catalogue). Scored with the official evaluate.py: score = (0.4 + 0.6 x earliness if final right else 0) - 1.0 x wrong commits - 0.02 x wasted searches (mean x 100). Agent: app/official_agent.py, run 2026-11-25. Per-request log: eval/outputs/official_results.jsonl.

self_made_devset.description: Original 40-request dev set on the 100-product demo catalogue (data/devset.json, eval/run_eval.py). Full-text requests; metrics are category / budget / top-1 / top-3 / latency.
